Keep aggregation focused on variations of one capability

Aggregation services combine several implementations of the same service concern. These rules prevent aggregation from becoming general orchestration and make its intentionally broad dependency shape distinguishable from an accidental dependency hub.

The value of enforcing this family

The result is one controlled place to reconcile variations while their individual contracts remain independently usable.
